en: Colorized historic postcard showing an ornate multi‑story villa with steep red roofs, a tall pointed turret, and decorative balconies, set in a landscaped garden with paths, flowerbeds, and a small pavilion. The setting overlooks a valley or hills in the background. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as "Karlsbad, Westend 'Villa Strunz'"; additional small-print text is along the left and right margins.
